Name: Zuzu Frights
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=4]The Festival includes a custom dungeon with 3 parts, New Monsters, a New Mineral, and Two Currencies(which can be exchanged for prizes).[/size]

[size=4]You can access the Festival from the [b]22th to 26th of Fall[/b].[b] [/b][/size]

[size=4]A new egg can be found in the dungeon, that can be incubated in a Coop Incubator![/size]

[size=4]Installation:
﻿[/size]
